svg.title: Ten Closings From One Tracked Annual Cohort
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-mandate-conversion-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: Ten Closings From One Tracked Annual Cohort; subtitle: A mature pipeline illustration supporting $550,000 in retained commissions.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: The five stages are nested counts from the same 200-owner cohort, observed across its complete sales cycle. They are planning assumptions, not measured conversion benchmarks. Ten completed transactions at $55,000 retained commission each produce the canonical $550,000 Base-Case annual revenue. A steady-state annual pipeline can contain overlapping cohorts.; caption: Stage conversions are 50%, 40%, 50%, and 50%; overall owner-to-close conversion is 5%. Deduplicate seller mandates rather than counting multiple buyer conversations as separate deals.; stages: label: Relevant owner accounts; value: 200 screened owners with a documented transaction thesis.; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Research owners inside one specialist sector and record a plausible sale trigger, asset profile, decision-maker, and permitted contact channel. Purchased contact volume alone does not qualify an account.; label: Qualified seller discussions; value: 100 owners confirm authority, motivation, timing, and fit.; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Fifty percent of the screened cohort completes a substantive discussion. Capture valuation expectations, records availability, ownership structure, and willingness to disclose defects before offering representation.; label: Executed exclusive mandates; value: 40 sellers execute scoped mandates with workable fee terms.; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Forty percent of qualified discussions becomes an exclusive engagement. Record fee triggers, buyer exclusions, conflicts, termination rights, and tail dates; an unsigned proposal remains outside the mandate count.; label: Signed transaction LOIs; value: 20 mandated sellers reach documented preliminary transaction terms.; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Half the executed mandates reaches a signed LOI with a qualified buyer. Count each seller mandate once, even if a replacement buyer later signs another LOI after the first transaction fails.; label: Completed commission events; value: 10 closings earn $55,000 each in retained commissions.; numeric value: 10.0; detail: Half the LOI-stage mandates closes. An illustrative $1,100,000 asset price at a 5% retained commission produces $55,000; the resulting $11,000,000 aggregate asset value is excluded from operator revenue.

text.title: Ten Closings From One Tracked Annual Cohort
text.tspan: Ten Closings From One Tracked Annual Cohort

circle.title: label: Relevant owner accounts; value: 200 screened owners with a documented transaction thesis.; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Research owners inside one specialist sector and record a plausible sale trigger, asset profile, decision-maker, and permitted contact channel. Purchased contact volume alone does not qualify an account.

label: Qualified seller discussions; value: 100 owners confirm authority, motivation, timing, and fit.; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Fifty percent of the screened cohort completes a substantive discussion. Capture valuation expectations, records availability, ownership structure, and willingness to disclose defects before offering representation.

label: Executed exclusive mandates; value: 40 sellers execute scoped mandates with workable fee terms.; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Forty percent of qualified discussions becomes an exclusive engagement. Record fee triggers, buyer exclusions, conflicts, termination rights, and tail dates; an unsigned proposal remains outside the mandate count.

label: Signed transaction LOIs; value: 20 mandated sellers reach documented preliminary transaction terms.; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Half the executed mandates reaches a signed LOI with a qualified buyer. Count each seller mandate once, even if a replacement buyer later signs another LOI after the first transaction fails.

label: Completed commission events; value: 10 closings earn $55,000 each in retained commissions.; numeric value: 10.0; detail: Half the LOI-stage mandates closes. An illustrative $1,100,000 asset price at a 5% retained commission produces $55,000; the resulting $11,000,000 aggregate asset value is excluded from operator revenue.

text.title: Assumptions: The five stages are nested counts from the same 200-owner cohort, observed across its complete sales cycle. They are planning assumptions, not measured conversion benchmarks. Ten completed transactions at $55,000 retained commission each produce the canonical $550,000 Base-Case annual revenue. A steady-state annual pipeline can contain overlapping cohorts.
